name: Freaky Night At Fairy's
source:
Do you like Fairy? Do you love Fairy? Do you want to... make direct eye contact with Fairy? How scandalous. This game was made for romantic deviants who indulge in activities such as h*nd-h*lding and sleeping after 10:00P.M. People of all ages beware.

This is the parodical sequel to GATE 37. Upon waking up in an awfully familiar place, you meet him again, but all he seems to want is for you to teach him... something..?

[From [url=https://crrn.itch.io/freaky-nights-at-fairys]Itch.io[/url]]
